# Moddy Arena

Moddy Arena, a Moddy world: a prep room beside a walled arena, where waves of mobs come to fight.

- **A prep room and an arena**: make wishes with the Builder or the Apprentice in the prep room and put them on your
  hotbar; in a battle only the hotbar's wishes work.
- **The control panel** on the prep room's wall sets the difficulty (which also sets how many monsters a wave brings)
  and the waves (5, 10, 15, 20 or Endless), and starts a battle: waves that start easy and get harder, a boss every
  5th wave, never player against player. Each player has 3 lives in a battle.
- **The Champions board** shows the best runs at the panel's settings.

Make a world with **Create World, World tab, World Type: Moddy Arena**, and play it in Survival, with the game's
difficulty above Peaceful.

By **Moddy contributors**. Report problems [on its issue tracker](https://github.com/jivinstev/Moddy-Worlds/issues).

**Scope:** NeoForge. Each release names the Minecraft version it is for.

## Requirements

- Required: the Moddy core (mod id `moddingfromamod`), the release that this world's release notes name.

## Known issues

Known issues and their status: [its issue tracker](https://github.com/jivinstev/Moddy-Worlds/issues).

## How releases are made

Every release is built from https://github.com/jivinstev/Moddy-Worlds by its own build, passes automated checks (it
builds, its unit tests pass, and it loads on a dedicated server with the Moddy core), and is played by a person before
it becomes a full release.
